title: Bounded-field mixture compiler for positive low-rank Ising interactions

theorems.claim: Pointwise joint envelope with conditional mean acceptance >= (1-rho) exp(-2b).
Rejection-free finite mixture: TV <= rho+2b and log-partition bias <= b-log(1-rho).
Fixed-rank, inverse-polynomial-residual-gap polynomial-bit sampling and log-partition approximation; arbitrary rational positive-spike strength.
Constant-resolution ideal rejection acceptance >= 3 exp(-1/4)/4 independent of positive-spike strengths.

imports: Rational linear algebra and linear programming
Classical convex-volume FPRAS and well-guaranteed-oracle rounding
limitations: numeric dependence on residual gap inverse remains
exact rational model factors are supplied, not experimentally learned
general Gaussian-cell integration and high-temperature base pipeline not implemented
negative-spike counterpart obstructed by known rank-one hardness
next_decisive_gate: Resolve whether weighted-field-cell aggregation can improve n^{O(r)} to a parameterized or structured-growing-rank bound, with matched discrete output and binary costs; check parameterized hardness rather than assuming an unrestricted rank-polynomial theorem.

implementation_attempts.all_mpmath_moderate_coupling: 45-second and 120-second capped attempts did not complete
